# airlock_group (Resource)

Manage an Airlock policy group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "airlock_group" "example" {
  name   = "tf-example-group"
  hidden = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.

### Optional

- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the group is hidden.
- `parent` (String) Parent group name or ID, if Airlock requires one.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Airlock object ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import airlock_group.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
